verdict.rationale: Vestd has a dedicated HRIS Integration page that says you can 'connect your HR platform to Vestd and end the manual data shuffle,' so some HR-to-equity sync is claimed. The evidence does not say which HRIS or payroll systems are supported, or that new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically. Missing for 10: named supported HRIS/payroll providers (e.g. Gusto, Rippling), documented automatic sync of new hires into stakeholder records, termination/leaver handling flowing into equity records, sync frequency/mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
